labels.label: bbsrem:cuttachyon2
labels.notes: Still unmarked and partial. AUDIT-1 major (finding 1) is resolved. SCOPE (c) (HSLinkRemarks.lean:94-108), the module header (:12-22), the checklist row for the two clauses (:76), and the REPORT findings[0..1] now state the convention-free fact: under one side-of-line rule, positivity does not depend on the orientation of r, so the two printed clauses cannot both hold (isPositive_iff_past, isPositive_iff_future, bbsrem_cuttachyon2_reading). Which clause fails is stated per convention. Under the library's convention (IsLiftedDev D(s+1) = f(D s)) with src = true, the future clause fails. Under the gluing-map convention of the paper's examples, the past clause fails. I re-derived the second case: flipping the sign turns isPositive_iff_past into 'positive iff gamma pushes r into its future' for both orientations, so the future clause holds and the past one fails. The text explicitly says no restatement should follow before the convention is ruled. The claim that l.1295-1296 (AdS) agrees with « past » is gone from SCOPE and from the REPORT. The AdS sentence now appears only in the list of passages consistent with the gluing-map convention, which matches AUDIT-1's analysis. The paper's l.1290-1296 makes no claim about 'the holonomy', so 'consistent with' is the accurate wording. not_cuttachyon2_future_printed's docstring (:966-973) now says 'Relative to the library's holonomy convention ... and to the rule l.1303-1304 read literally', and it states the flip. No 'false as printed' or 'reversed' wording remains (grep for false/wrong/reversed/error/refut: only code tokens). The « γ is the inverse of the holonomy » row (:71) is now ⚠ read, as AUDIT-1's minor asked. The REPORT hypotheses[4] is now 'read'. The new question on the holonomy convention of record (extends OQ-120 (c), names HSPositive and exists_positive_negative as possibly affected) is present in REPORT questions[1]. No cuttachyon2 entry exists in papers/bbs/certificate/restatements.toml. Statements: the signatures of IsCutGlueLink, exists_isCutGlueLink, cutGlueHol, SourceFirst, core, hasType, isPositive_iff_past, isPositive_iff_future, bbsrem_cuttachyon2_reading and not_cuttachyon2_future_printed match AUDIT-1's description: the src parameter, Gamma_x minus {1}, both positivity forms, the ray Ioo 0 eps, and not_cuttachyon2 with src = true and the unused _hwf. AUDIT-1 kept no copy of the file, so this check compares against AUDIT-1's description, not a byte diff.

findings.what: The docstring still glosses the definition as '(l.1304, « γ is the inverse of the holonomy »)' and does not mention the convention. The checklist row and SCOPE now say that this sentence is a convention statement which cutGlueHol replaces rather than formalizes, but a reader of the definition alone would take it as the formal content of l.1304.
